name: @gati/cli
description: Command-line tool, Vite plugin integration, and static security/a11y auditor for Gati applications.

scripts.build: esbuild src/bin.ts --bundle --alias:@gati/compiler=../compiler/src/index.ts --alias:@gati/security=../security/src/index.ts --alias:@gati/reactivity=../reactivity/src/index.ts --alias:@gati/runtime=../runtime/src/index.ts --platform=node --format=esm --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node" --outfile=bin/gati.js && cp bin/gati.js bin/aether.js
